explication: GoProxy is a multi-protocol proxy and tunneling server. The principal workflow is a client request entering a configured proxy service, being parsed or forwarded, optionally routed through a parent proxy, and relayed to a destination. The graph includes the HTTP routing/authentication stages, TCP and UDP forwarding, and tunnel endpoints. README capabilities such as SOCKS5, WebSocket, load balancing, and protocol conversion are documented but their implementations are not identifiable from the sampled source, so they are represented only as a documented feature area under services/.
